newsitem.title: USA: Dauphin Deposit names unit president.
newsitem.headline: Dauphin Deposit names unit president.

text.p: Dauphin Deposit Corp said Wednesday that Susan Keating has been named president and chief executive of Dauphin Deposit Bank and Trust Co, succeeding Christopher Jennings, who announced his retirement earlier this week.
Dauphin said Keating's appointment takes effect July 8, when Allied Irish Banks Plc is scheduled to complete its acquisition of Dauphin Deposit Corp.
Dauphin Deposit is to be a subsidiary of AIB's U.S. bank holding company, First Maryland Bancorp, after the merger.

Dauphin said Keating is currently executive vice president and head of the retail bank for First Maryland. She will manage Dauphin Deposit Bank and its divisions, Bank of Pennsylvania, Farmers Bank and Valleybank, and First Maryland subsidiary, York Bank and Trust Co, in her new role, the bank said.
